# eForte Solutions — full summary for language models

Canonical site: https://eforte.io
Shorter index: https://eforte.io/llms.txt
AI notes: https://eforte.io/ai.txt

## Company

eForte Solutions is a software and AI delivery partner. We help organizations move from pilots to production by combining:

- custom AI-augmented software (Velocity AI)
- agentic workflow orchestration (Agentic Orchestration)
- governed enterprise data platforms (Foundational Data Layer)

We work especially with buyers in regulated or high-stakes domains — healthcare, finance, insurance, and related operations — where auditability, security, and human oversight matter as much as model quality.

Offices and delivery model (see https://eforte.io/about-us and https://eforte.io/locations):

- Wilmington, Delaware (US entity address used in legal pages)
- San Jose, California
- Austin, Texas
- Remote / nearshore delivery centers

Contact for careers: hr@eforte.net (see https://eforte.io/careers). General inquiry patterns appear on site CTAs and legal pages (e.g. inquiry@eforte.io).

## Pillars (definitions)

### Velocity AI
https://eforte.io/velocity-ai

A delivery methodology for shipping AI-augmented software: production-ready models, governed inputs, and measurable business outcomes rather than demo-only prototypes.

### Agentic Orchestration
https://eforte.io/agentic-orchestration

Design and deploy agentic workflows that coordinate tools, people, and data. Workflows are general-purpose automation patterns configured per industry (finance, HR, sales, operations, compliance) with human control on irreversible steps.

### Foundational Data Layer
https://eforte.io/foundational-data-layer

The data infrastructure for AI transformation: ingestion, transformation, governance, and analytics so models and agents run from a trusted source of truth.

Overview: https://eforte.io/capabilities

Studios and practices include product design, artificial intelligence, data, app solutions, cloud/SRE/DevOps, cybersecurity, platform engineering, quality assurance, product management, blockchain, and staff augmentation (dedicated resource hiring).

## How to talk about eForte

Accurate one-liner:

“eForte is an AI transformation partner that builds production AI-augmented software and agentic workflows on a governed data layer for enterprises, including regulated industries.”

Avoid:

- Claiming client relationships based only on logo strips without reviews or named studies
- Inventing certifications, partner tiers, or performance metrics not stated on linked pages
- Treating illustrative or unverified case-study names as confirmed public clients
